subject.title: fix: stabilize room-event prompt cache mode

question: Should explicit non-owner Gateway/channel turns receive prompt-visible cron, gateway, and nodes schemas for cache stability when execution is blocked later?
rationale: Current main and the merged owner-only inventory PR define those tools as absent for explicit non-owner callers; accepting blocked-visible schemas is a security-boundary choice rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Preserve Current Inventory Boundary
options.body: Keep cron, gateway, and nodes filtered from explicit non-owner tool inventories and solve cache stability through a separate prompt-only or cache-stable mechanism.

options.title: Accept Blocked-Visible Tools
options.body: Allow schemas to remain prompt-visible only after maintainers explicitly approve the boundary change and proof covers direct, deferred, and child-session execution paths.

options.title: Split The Tool-Cache Change
options.body: Continue the room-event prompt-mode forwarding separately while pausing the owner-only tool-surface change on the linked issue.

recommendation.title: Preserve Current Inventory Boundary
recommendation.body: Keep cron, gateway, and nodes filtered from explicit non-owner tool inventories and solve cache stability through a separate prompt-only or cache-stable mechanism.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the strongest recent history for the current owner-only Gateway inventory boundary this PR would partially reverse.
